SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) AS line_cnt, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity < 0 THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units,
       min(f.sale_ts_utc) AS min_ts, max(f.sale_ts_utc) AS max_ts, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS loaded
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
GROUP BY f.sale_date ORDER BY f.sale_date

SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.vat_rate, f.standard_cost, f.staff_purchase_flag,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line g WHERE g.receipt_id = f.receipt_id AND g.line_no = f.line_no) AS dup_receipt_line,
       (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id) AS qty_returned_all_time,
       (SELECT min(r.return_date) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id) AS first_return
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
ORDER BY f.sale_ts_utc

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY f.sale_date)
SELECT r.business_date, r.units_sold AS rpt_units, f.units AS fact_units, r.receipts AS rpt_receipts, f.receipts AS fact_receipts, r.net_sales_before_returns AS rpt_net, f.net_before_returns AS fact_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r FULL JOIN f ON f.sale_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 131 AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.sku = 101624 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name
